nodes.name: CRM Event
nodes.notes: Copy this node's Production URL into the CRM under Automations → Outgoing → New webhook, and tick which events you want.

nodes.name: High Value or Urgent?
nodes.notes: Only shout about leads worth shouting about. Adjust the ₹1,00,000 threshold to suit, or delete this node to alert on everything.

nodes.name: Send Alert
nodes.notes: Works as-is with a Slack incoming webhook or Google Chat. For WhatsApp, swap this for your provider's node (Twilio, Gupshup, WATI) and map $json.message into the message body. For email, replace with a Gmail or Send Email node.
